name: sanabot-skills
description: Sana Bot — agent skills for the Sana super-app on Solana. Wraps the hosted MCP gateway at mcp.sana.bot so your agent can answer questions about your wallet, prices, transactions, and card using your Sana API key.

interface.shortDescription: Wallet, prices, transactions & card for your agent — via the hosted Sana Bot MCP gateway.
interface.longDescription: Sana Bot bundles agent skills for the Sana super-app on Solana. Routes every call through the hosted MCP gateway at mcp.sana.bot using your Sana API key — no local infrastructure. Three skill packs: using-sanabot (foundation: connection, tool catalogue, scopes, error handling), sanafi-portfolio (net worth, holdings, prices, account, notifications), and sanafi-card (card metadata, spending power, card transactions). Requires a Sana API key exposed as the SANABOT_API_KEY environment variable.
